classification_basis: The study owner confirmed this is the confirmatory human study. Its four-comparator/two-question endpoint family and analysis were frozen before collection. This classification applies to the prespecified endpoint analysis; it does not assert full compliance with every frozen assignment or provenance requirement.
primary_result: All eight point estimates exceed 0.5, but no endpoint survives Holm correction.
execution_deviations: 0/40 uploaded per-slot task schedules match the frozen schedule, including matching against any frozen slot pattern.
Left/right orientation is fixed within all 96 object-by-comparison cells; the aggregate orientation is balanced 12/12 per comparator across objects.
The export does not record randomization seed, question order, raw comprehension answers, or a frozen-stimulus image-hash crosswalk.
A coordinator complete/withdrawn closeout log and ethics/consent documentation were not provided in the evidence package.
allowed_claim: Report the full pre-specified set of relative 2D human-preference endpoints as a confirmatory analysis with execution deviations; conclude that no multiplicity-adjusted LLH preference advantage was detected.
not_supported: equivalence or non-inferiority versus generic linear
unseen-view, baked-3D, seam, or full-PBR quality
full protocol adherence or independently verified participant-side stimulus identity
does_not_change: The original 01549 3AFC remains scoped to C3/TCAS and its original uniform-scale baselines.
The scientific evidence freeze remains YES only for its bounded claims.
Reviewer closure remains PARTIAL and direct system upload remains HOLD.
Public release/retention of already-uploaded participant-level rows and consent/ethics status remain separate governance questions.
